summary: Firefox now applies stronger checks to navigation and session history, including limits on which processes can set browsing state and safeguards for URLs and history entries supplied by content. It can also retry HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 requests after an unclean shutdown, and improves handling of search-like address-bar input and page-load errors. These changes help make navigation more dependable and protect the browser’s boundaries between web content and browser-controlled state.
